issues.issue: Broad line that mixes several sources. On the p5 budget schedule (budgetary basis), state/county lines (Care Management Income, Case Management/Level of Care, CASA, county match) total 2,371,155 of 4,702,265 in grants (about 50.4%). Federal lines (OAA, NSIP, Title XX, Transportation programs) total 2,092,207, and client/other contributions 280,114. So state aid is only barely the dominant category, and the result depends on how Transportation programs and Case Management are classed. Already marked review.
